title: A credit dated on the as-of date stays in the same bucket as before
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A customer has an unused credit memo dated on the as-of date, and you check it stays in the same bucket.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an unused credit memo {Credit-memo-A} dated {Date-A}; before the release you noted which A/R Detail bucket it was in with {Date-A} as the as-of date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST REL-08 Same Day Credit; {Date-A} is the day before the release.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Date-A} as the as-of date and {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it is in the same bucket as before the release (today that is "1-30 days past due"): this release does not change how credits are aged.

Changing how such a credit is aged is a separate ticket (SV-11441) outside this release, so this release must leave it as it is.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • Out of Scope: “Other improvements found in research, each a separate ticket on SV-11315: a credit dated on the as-of date landing in 1-30 instead of Current (SV-11441, checked against QuickBooks first); configurable aging periods (SV-11442); send a statement from the report (SV-11443); salesperson and Parts vs Service filters (SV-11444); last payment date and credit limit (SV-11446); a collections notes log (SV-11447).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
